description: Controller class 'SaveEmployeeReportController' for handling the creation and editing of employee reports in the OrangeHRM PIM module. It prepares a Vue component with necessary properties for report filtering and display.

classes.name: SaveEmployeeReportController
classes.description: Controller for saving or editing employee reports, extending AbstractVueController and utilizing traits for report generation and internationalization.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with report data, including selection criteria, display field groups, and display fields based on the request attributes.

methods.name: preRender
